title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to design and implement a transformative agenda on gender equality, non-discrimination and inclusion

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area. (1) Knowledge and evidence on emerging forms of discrimination facilitated by artificial intelligence and other digital technologies (2) Policy guidance and tools on equality, diversity and inclusion, with a focus on persons with disabilities and on people facing racial discrimination (3) Knowledge on the underlying causes and impacts of gender-based industrial and sectoral occupational segregation, including in relation to equal pay for work of equal value (4) Knowledge and awareness raising on the nexus between climate change, gender equality and inclusion and just transitions, with special attention to the needs of indigenous peoples, including in rural areas (5) As a co-sponsor of the Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS), advancement of the ILO’s approaches and standards in implementing the Global Aids Strategy aimed at reducing inequalities that drive the HIV epidemic in the world of work.
